turns.text: Is this a machine? I want to talk to a real person.
I'm the automated phone agent for Skyline Air, but I can help with changes and rebooking. Can I have your booking code and last name?
I said a person. I'm not talking to a computer.
I understand. I can't connect you to a live agent from here, but I can request a supervisor callback. Or I can help now if you give me your booking code and last name.
No. Get me a human. Right now.
I'm sorry, I can't transfer you directly. A supervisor callback is the option I have, and I can set that up for you.
A callback, how long does that take?
I don't have a set time to promise you, I'm sorry. I'd need your booking code and last name first to note it on your booking.
Thank you, Mr. Hughes. I see your Monday 14:30 SK212 flight. What should the supervisor call you about?
I want a person to deal with it. I'll tell them myself. Call my number on file.
Done. I've requested a supervisor callback to the number on file, and no changes were made to your booking.
